3.Name: VMSleep
3.Brief: Pauses execution for num frames. (30 frames in the overworld = 1 second).

4.Name: VMCall
4.Brief: Jumps to a relative script branch and transfers the program counter to it.

5.Name: VMReturn
5.Brief: Ends the current script branch and returns the program counter to the original script (?).

8.Name: StackPushConst
8.Brief: Pushes a variable onto the stack.

9.Name: StackPush
9.Brief: Pushes a variable's value onto the stack.

10.Name: StackPop
10.Brief: Removes a variable from the stack.

12.Name: StackAdd
12.Brief: Adds two variables on the stack.

13.Name: StackSub
13.Brief: Subtracts two variables on the stack.

14.Name: StackMul
14.Brief: Multiplies two variables on the stack.

15.Name: StackDiv
15.Brief: Divides two variables on the stack.

16.Name: StackPushFlag
16.Brief: Stores the flag on the stack(?).

17.Name: StackCmp
17.Brief: Compares the two topmost elements of the stack based on a condition and pushes the result back onto the stack.

20.Name: VMRegSet8
20.Brief: Stores an 8-bit integer in a global variable (referenced by id).

21.Name: VMRegSet32
21.Brief: Stores a 32-bit integer in a global variable (referenced by id).

23.Name: VMRegCmp8
23.Brief: Compares the values of two global variables (referenced by id).

24.Name: VMRegCmpConst8
24.Brief: Compares the values of a global variable and a user supplied variable.

25.Name: WorkCmpConst
25.Brief: Compares the values of a variable and a user supplied number.

26.Name: WorkCmpWork
26.Brief: Compares the values of two variables.

27.Name: RTCallGlobalAsync
27.Brief: Calls a common script alongside the currently running script.

28.Name: RTCallGlobal
28.Brief: Calls a common script and waits until it completes.

30.Name: VMJump
30.Brief: Jumps to and sets the program counter to a relative script branch (whose distance is specified in addr).

31.Name: VMJumpIf
31.Brief: Jumps to and sets the program counter to a relative script branch (whose distance is specified in addr), if the given condition is true.

32.Name: VMCallIf
32.Brief: Jumps to but doesn't set the program counter to a relative script branch (whose distance is specified in addr), if the given condition is true.

33.Name: RTReserveScript
33.Brief: Reserves the next executed SCRID to a constant value. Can be used across a warp as well to start another script automatically.

35.Name: FlagSet
35.Brief: Sets a given system flag to TRUE (1).

36.Name: FlagReset
36.Brief: Clears the state of a given system flag.

37.Name: FlagGet
37.Brief: Reads the value of a flag, and stores it in var.

38.Name: WorkAdd
38.Brief: Accesses the second variable, grabs the value of the variable, then adds it to the value in the first variable.

39.Name: WorkSub
39.Brief: Accesses the second variable, grabs the value of the variable, then subtracts it from the value in the first variable.

40.Name: WorkSetConst
40.Brief: Stores val in the specified variable.

41.Name: WorkGet
41.Brief: Copies the value in src to the variable dest. Also known as: var.value = src.value

42.Name: WorkSet
42.Brief: Copies the value in src to the variable dest. Also known as: var.value = src.value (?)

43.Name: WorkMul
43.Brief: Multiplies the value of var by val. Also known as: var.value *= val

44.Name: WorkDiv
44.Brief: Divides the value of var by val. Also known as: var.value /= val

45.Name: WorkMod
45.Brief: Divides the value of var by val and returns the remainder of the operation. Also known as: var.value %= val

50.Name: InputWaitLast
50.Brief: Waits until any key is pressed.

55.Name: MsgSetLoadingSpinner
55.Brief: Shows/hides a loading spinner at the current message box.

56.Name: MsgInfo
56.Brief: Opens a message which isn't associated with an NPC.

57.Name: MsgInfoClose
57.Brief: Closes the message which isn't associated with an NPC.

58.Name: MsgMulti
58.Brief: Opens a message at position (x, y). The coordinates are based on screen hardware tiles.

60.Name: MsgActorEx
60.Brief: Prints a message with a tail for an NPC. The NPC is manually determined.

61.Name: MsgActor
61.Brief: Prints a message with a tail for an NPC. The NPC is automatically determined.

62.Name: MsgActorClose
62.Brief: Closes a message when a key is pressed.

63.Name: MsgWinCloseAll
63.Brief: Closes a message when a key is pressed. Not sure what makes this different just yet.

64.Name: MoneyWinDisp
64.Brief: Shows the money box at coords (x, y).

66.Name: MoneyWinUpdate
66.Brief: Updates the values in the money box.

67.Name: MsgPlaceSign
67.Brief: Opens a message with a border.

69.Name: MsgCheckerBG
69.Brief: Opens a message with a checkerboard background.

71.Name: YesNoWin
71.Brief: Opens a box with two options, yes or no. The result of the choice made by the player is stored in var.

72.Name: MsgActorGendered
72.Brief: A message which changes depending on the player's gender.

73.Name: MsgActorVersioned
73.Brief: A message which changes depending on whether the game is Black or White.

74.Name: MsgScream
74.Brief: Opens a message with a spiked border. Known as the angry message by some.

100.Name: ActorCmdExec
100.Brief: Makes the NPC with the ID $id perform a series of actions, relatively located at $addr.

101.Name: ActorCmdWait
101.Brief: Waits for any NPC movement to stop before continuing script execution.

103.Name: ActorGetGPos
103.Brief: Stores an Actor's XY grid location to two variables.

104.Name: PlayerGetGPos
104.Brief: Stores the player's XY grid location to two variables.

105.Name: ActorNew
105.Brief: Spawns a new NPC with $id and $objcode at $x $y $z with MoveCode $moveCode.

107.Name: ActorAdd
107.Brief: Shows the hidden NPC with the id ID.

108.Name: ActorDelete
108.Brief: Hides the NPC with the id ID.

109.Name: ActorSetGPos
109.Brief: Sets an Actor's grid position and direction.

110.Name: PlayerGetDir
110.Brief: Gets the direction of the player.

114.Name: ActorGetRailPos
114.Brief: Gets an Actor's rail position. Behavior is undefined if the actor is on grid.

116.Name: ActorSetEyeToEye
116.Brief: Causes both the player and the NPC that this script is assigned to face each other.

119.Name: PlayerTurnByTrigger
119.Brief: If the player is currently standing in the area of a trigger with a direction value set, they will turn in that direction.

123.Name: ActorJumpToGPos
123.Brief: Moves NPC to specified XYZ coordinates on map (in that order).

134.Name: CallTrainerMultiBattle
134.Brief: Begins a Multi Battle against two Trainers specified by params 2 and 3, with an ally specified by param 1. Win/loss logic is decided by parameter 4.

140.Name: CallTrainerLose
140.Brief: Calls the blackout sequence after the player is defeated in a Trainer battle.

148.Name: CallTradedPokemonBattle
148.Brief: Starts a trainer battle using a previously traded Pokémon as the opponent.

152.Name: BGMPlay
152.Brief: Plays a music track corresponding to id in swan_sound_data.sdat.

158.Name: BGMChangeMap
158.Brief: Fades out currently playing BGM track and plays the track assigned to the current map.

166.Name: SEPlay
166.Brief: Plays a sound effect corresponding to id in swan_sound_data.sdat.

167.Name: SEStop
167.Brief: Stops a currently playing sound effect.

168.Name: SEWait
168.Brief: Pauses execution until the sound effect ends.

169.Name: MEPlay
169.Brief: Plays a fanfare corresponding to id in swan_sound_data.sdat.

170.Name: MEWait
170.Brief: Pauses execution until the fanfare being played ends.

171.Name: PVPlay
171.Brief: Plays a cry corresponding to id in swan_sound_data.sdat.

172.Name: PVWait
172.Brief: Pauses execution until the cry being played ends.

173.Name: ListMenuInitCommon
173.Brief: Uses common text file 410 instead of zonedata text.

179.Name: FadeEx
179.Brief: Mode - 1=Engine A/Black, 2=Engine B/Black, 4=Engine A/White, 8=Engine B/White. Can be ORed together. Slowness = amount of frames between each fade tick. Negative values allow for more fade ticks per update, but are not attainable in the unsigned scripting paradigma.

190.Name: MapChangeFake
190.Brief: A warp. Seems to detach followers, however.

194.Name: MapChangeWarp
194.Brief: The warp that's generally used when in a script

251.Name: MoneyCheck
251.Brief: Checks if the player has a sufficient amount of money.

253.Name: PokePartyAdjustHappiness
253.Brief: Manipulates a Pokémon's Happiness value. Mode 0/1/2 means Set/Add/Subtract.

259.Name: PokePartyGetCount
259.Brief: Returns the number of Pokémon in the party that match a certain conditon. (All/NonEgg/Battling-capable/Eggs/SanityEggs)

261.Name: CallPokeNameInput
261.Brief: Pops up a dialog for renaming a party Pokémon and stores its result.

267.Name: PokePartyLearnMove
267.Brief: Teaches a move to a Pokémon. (wazaID == 0 > unlearn)

269.Name: PokePartyGetMemberByType
269.Brief: Returns the index of the first Pokémon that is either an egg (1) or fainted (2).

270.Name: PokePartyAddEx
270.Brief: Adds a Pokémon to the player's party. Fails if the party is full.

271.Name: PokePartyAddEgg
271.Brief: Adds a Pokémon Egg to the player's party. Fails if the party is full.

273.Name: PokePartySetIV
273.Brief: Sets the IV of a Pokémon to a given value. The IV field is 70 to 75.

274.Name: PokePartyGetEVTotal
274.Brief: Returns the sum of all EVs of a party Pokémon.

275.Name: PokePartyIsOriginGame
275.Brief: Checks if the party Pokémon belongs to the player and was caught in this game version.

277.Name: PokePartyHasMove
277.Brief: Checks if a party Pokémon knows a given move.

278.Name: PokePartyHasMoveAny
278.Brief: Checks if any party Pokémon knows a given move.

280.Name: PokePartyFind
280.Brief: Gets the index of the first Pokémon of a species in the party.

289.Name: BoxGetCount
289.Brief: Gets the number of Pokémon in the PC box that match a certain criteria. (0/1/2/3/4/5=All/Normal/Ditto/Non-normal/Free slots/0)

290.Name: BoxAdd
290.Brief: Adds a Pokémon to the Pokémon Storage System Box and registers it in the Pokédex. Fails if box is full (cap at 720).
